what: Plan keys design audit PR discovery to the wrong PR title shape
scenario_or_breakage: `design-log-publish.sh` creates PRs titled `chore(larch-logs): design run <RUN_ID>`, but the plan filters and maps `--skill=design` with `^chore\(larch-logs\): flush design run ...$`; design audits will find zero PRs or emit empty run mappings.
suggested_fix: Use the existing PR title regex `^chore\(larch-logs\): design run ([A-Za-z0-9._-]+)$`, or explicitly change the publisher title in the same PR if that is intended.

what: Design token scans would look for implement-style filenames
scenario_or_breakage: Committed design logs use `token-report-final.json` and `timing-report-final.json`, while the plan only swaps `LOG_BASE` and keeps `token-report.json` / `timing-report.json`; `--skill=design` would silently skip all current design runs.
suggested_fix: For `--skill=design`, read `token-report-final.json` and `timing-report-final.json`, or probe the final names first and fall back to legacy names; make the design fixtures use the real final filenames.

what: `--plot-from` cannot enforce skill-specific report titles if it only fetches the body
scenario_or_breakage: The plan promises `--skill=design --plot-from <legacy implement report>` is rejected, but the current fetch path writes only `.body` to the analyzer; a body parser cannot tell `[Analysis Report]` from `[Design Analysis Report]`.
suggested_fix: Fetch `title,body` for `--plot-from`, validate the title against the selected skill before parsing the raw data block, then pass only the body to the existing loader.

what: New prefixed audit reports are not excluded from bug-issue dedupe searches
scenario_or_breakage: The plan changes audit report titles to `[Implement Run Logs Audit ...]` and `[Design Run Logs Audit ...]`, but the proposed bug-issue action rules still exclude only `^\[Run Logs Audit .* Report\]`; future audit-report issues can match finding keyword searches and be mistaken for open/closed bug issues.
suggested_fix: Update the audit-report noise exclusion to cover legacy, implement-prefixed, and design-prefixed audit titles wherever finding dedupe filters issue search results.
